request.style: English, Male solo voice, warm and intimate, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drum kit, gentle, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
While we were still helpless and weak
The right time came for the Savior to speak
Not with words of power or fear
But with a heart laid bare and near

[Verse]
Rarely does one die for the good
Or for the just as it should
We were ungodly, far away
But he did not turn us away

[Chorus]
God proves his love in this alone
While we were sinners on the throne
Of our own brokenness and shame
Christ died for us, the same

[Verse]
Justified now by his blood
Saved from wrath through his good
Enemies reconciled by grace
His life gives us a sacred place

[Chorus]
God proves his love in this alone
While we were sinners on the throne
Of our own brokenness and shame
Christ died for us, the same

[Bridge]
How much more saved by his life
When death was the bitter strife
We boast in God through the Lord
Reconciliation in this word

[Chorus]
God proves his love in this alone
While we were sinners on the throne
Of our own brokenness and shame
Christ died for us, the same

[Outro]
Christ died for us
Love proved in death
